title: Boiler Inspection Service Request Form
subtitle: Boiler Inspection: defines need, constraints, and assignment.
description: Boiler Inspection Service Request Form covers boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop. The facility boiler coordinator records Boiler Inspection need, timing, access, and assignment. Boiler Inspection Service Request Form keeps Boiler Inspection exceptions visible until the facility boiler coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Boiler Inspection Service Request Form at boiler room, fuel entry, flue route, and served mechanical system. Document boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop identity before Boiler Inspection begins. Compare boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop findings with stated Boiler Inspection criteria; route unresolved Boiler Inspection issues to qualified boiler or combustion-system reviewer. For Boiler Inspection Service Request Form, confirm requirements for Boiler Inspection. Ask qualified boiler or combustion-system reviewer to review Boiler Inspection conditions beyond the facility boiler coordinator's role.

sections.title: Requested-service contact and source record
sections.guidance: For Boiler Inspection, identify responsible parties, boiler room, fuel entry, flue route, and served mechanical system, and the linked boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop source.

sections.guidance: Resolve open Boiler Inspection request questions; have facility boiler coordinator record the assignment, response owner, and requester follow-up while keeping the record strictly at the intake and routing stage.

blocks.guidance: Do not assign or authorize the Boiler Inspection request when a fuel, combustion, pressure-boundary, venting, or required safety-control concern remains. Retain information supplied with the request and route unresolved constraints to facility boiler coordinator.
